value.rationale: All-coefficient stability feasibility is a motivated problem for the known three-dimensional bifurcation map. The theorem identifies a universal two-invariant Floquet spectrum and a sharp obstruction on one physical coefficient, proving no arbitrary adjustment of five other parameters can stabilize a 2-cycle outside the exact interval. This is substantively stronger than the already published implicit quartic and numerical bifurcation sections, and yields explicit permitted realizations.
